thread:
erin_pm: Vendor just pushed an updated ETA. H200 GA moved two weeks; B200 mid-run power caveat flagged. Need a rapid cross-org sync to pin embargo and marketplace gating.

lucas_vendor: Confirmed. H200 target now 2025-04-18. B200 variant B200-Q shows thermal climb after 3hrs at full load. We have fw-candidate v1.4 that seems to help.

mira_eng: Can vendor share the minimal repro and firmware SHA? we'll need to update perf docs and CI thresholds if sustained power differs.

lucas_vendor: Uploading logs and fw-candidate sha-1a2b3 to partner bucket now. Short repro: longbench-io for 3hrs. Patch lowers temps ~4C in our runs.

noah_market: Marketplace rule: can't unlock SKU rows without signed image SHA, declared kernel/fw metadata, and regional availability. Marketing needs 7 business days after final artifacts for a co-announcement.

sasha_si: SI asks: final blob + SHA, integration checklist, and a 48h soak plan across US-EAST and EU-WEST. Acceptance: temp < 83C and perf_drop <= 9%.

erin_pm: Actions before sync:
- lucas_vendor: upload fw-candidate + logs + SKU impact (due: EOD tomorrow)
- mira_eng: PR for image tag + CI gating (due: +48h)
- sasha_si: SI soak template + rollback stub (due: +48h)
- noah_market: embargo draft + legal loop (due: sync)

mira_eng: Proposed tag: `redwood/mkt/{vendor}/{sku}/fw-{sha}`. I'll open CI gating PR.

lucas_vendor: We'll aim to deliver candidate artifacts tomorrow. If partner lab shows regressions, we'll notify and GA may slip up to 14 days.

erin_pm: Calendar invite incoming for a 30m triage. Drop blockers here before the call. :thumbsup:
